name: CLI
summary: The command-line surface — where contributors change command behavior, flags, and interactive prompts for init, create, implement, sync, and serve.

name: Web Viewer
summary: A local web UI served on port 4747 that lets developers browse the generated feature knowledge, with an optional live mode for triggering analysis from the browser.

name: Repository analysis
summary: Scans a codebase using Tree-sitter and git to build a repo map of files, symbols, and import graphs, then uses Claude to discover and categorize the repo's business and technical features.

name: Incremental sync
summary: Detects what changed since the last analysis and re-maps only newly discovered features, avoiding a full re-scan of the entire repository.

name: Feature knowledge creation
summary: Generates a paired knowledge file and skill for a specific area of the codebase via an interactive flow, giving the code agent precise context for future tasks.

name: Knowledge-driven implementation
summary: Implements code changes by feeding Claude the stored knowledge and skill for the relevant feature, so it skips re-learning and goes straight to execution.

name: Manifest compilation
summary: Parses markdown knowledge files, validates them against a Zod schema, verifies every code reference against the live repo, and produces a single manifest.json for the web viewer.

name: Agent skill deployment
summary: Deploys generated skills into the correct editor-specific directory (.claude/skills, .cursor/skills) so they are available to the code agent at task time.
